facts.fact: The Road Accident Fund seeks a service provider for end-to-end monitoring, detection and response on its existing in-house Microsoft Sentinel threat-detection solution (five years).
facts.system: Microsoft Sentinel TDR solution (Road Accident Fund)

facts.fact: SITA is inviting bids for a provider to architect, design, develop and test an incident management solution for SAPS, which has no single integrated system and runs outdated platforms (36 months).
